summary.headline: Neapolitan Astrological Texts
summary.text: Catalog of manuscript folios 417v–433v in a Neapolitan codex, listing astrological texts on zodiacal signs, inceptions, quadrants, declines, sign mixtures and classifications, the twelve parts, planetary authority, decans, exaltations and depressions, stellar sect, and the rising of the Dog. Authorities and sources include Julian of Laodicea, Paulus of Alexandria, Hephaestion, Heliodorus, Antiochus, and Alim, with cross-references to Florentine, Taurinese, and Mutinense codices.
